seo.title: Interactive ARC Raiders Loot Tracker: Quest Items, Projects & Recycling (Patch 1.7.0)
seo.desc: The ultimate Interactive Loot Tracker and Database for ARC Raiders (Patch 1.7.0 "Cold Snap"). Stop using static lists: Our tool shows you live exactly which Quest Items and Project Loot (e.g., for Flickering Flames or the Expedition) you currently need to keep. Decide instantly: Keep loot, Sell for cash, or Recycle for crafting materials. Master your inventory management and never accidentally sell critical quest items again.
seo.lootTableSub: Excerpt from our database for Patch 1.7.0. Includes prices, recycling yields, and usage.

faq.q1: ⚡ How does the interactive Quest & Project Tracker work?
faq.a1: Unlike static wikis, our tracker adapts to your progress. Select your active Quests (e.g., from Celeste or Shani) in the menu. The tool instantly flags all required Quest Items as "Keep". Once you finish a quest, check it off, and the status updates automatically.
faq.q2: ❄️ Which items to keep for the "Flickering Flames" event?
faq.a2: For the new Winter Project in Patch 1.7.0, you need specific items. Definitely keep: Candleberries, Empty Wine Bottles, Coffee Pots, and Plastic Parts. Our tracker automatically marks these as "Keep" while the event is active.
faq.a3: No! Even in Patch 1.7.0, ARC Powercells are essential for weapon upgrades at the workbench. Never sell them to vending machines; keep them for crafting.
faq.q4: Recycling Guide: What to do with "Unusable Weapons"?
faq.a4: You should almost always recycle Unusable Weapons and electronics like Geiger Counters. This is the most efficient way to get ARC Alloy needed for the new Expedition Project.
